tool.name: Finviz
tool.description: Finviz is a stock screener and chart site for NASDAQ, NYSE and AMEX. The free site uses delayed quotes. Elite adds real-time quotes, more filters, alerts and data export.
features: Stock screener, maps and quote pages
Free quotes are delayed. Elite quotes are real-time, including premarket and after-hours
Elite adds multi-layout charts, unlimited alerts and CSV or Excel export
Coverage stated on the site: NASDAQ, NYSE and AMEX

plans.name: Free
plans.detail: Registered account with delayed quotes and basic screener filters.

plans.name: Elite
plans.detail: Or $299.50 per year, shown as $24.96 per month. A free trial requires a card.

tool.pricing_note: Prices from the official Elite page on 11 Oct 2026. Refunds are described for the first 30 days.
